decks.notes: This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with a mix of aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to deal damage early and often, with cards like Lightning Bolt and Goblin Bombardment providing direct damage, while creatures like Amped Raptor and Ocelot Pride pressure opponents on the board. Static Prison helps control opposing creatures, allowing your creatures to attack freely. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Guide of Souls provide additional support and synergies with your creature base, while The One Ring acts as a powerful finisher. The deck aims to win the game before opponents can stabilize or gain momentum.

The main concept of the deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and spells in a Boros color combination. It includes powerful creatures like Amped Raptor and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, supported by removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment. The deck aims to quickly build a strong board presence and disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Static Prison. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds additional versatility and consistency to the deck. Overall, this Boros Aggro deck aims to win the game swiftly through aggressive attacks and disruption.

The Boros Aggro deck focuses on a fast-paced, aggressive strategy that puts pressure on the opponent early in the game. The deck includes efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Amped Raptor, as well as burn spells like Lightning Bolt to deal direct damage. It also includes support cards like Static Prison to control the board and protect your creatures. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency and versatility to the deck. This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently to secure victory.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's plans with a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. The deck utilizes various spells to control the board, refill the hand, and generate advantage over the opponent. With cards like Fatal Push for removal, Counterspell for countering key threats, and Thought Scour for card advantage, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent until it can close out the game with its powerful finishers like Murktide Regent and Abhorrent Oculus.

The key strategy of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells, discard spells, and removal. The deck aims to control the board by countering key threats, removing creatures, and disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Sink into Stupor. It also utilizes card advantage with spells like Thought Scour and Unearth to maintain control of the game. Kiora, the Rising Tide provides additional card draw and tempo advantage, while Abhorrent Oculus and Psychic Frog act as win conditions by locking down the opponent's creatures.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on powerful creatures and aggressive strategies to overwhelm the opponent quickly. By utilizing cards like Amped Raptor, Guide of Souls, and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah, the deck aims to deal damage swiftly and efficiently to secure a victory. Additionally, Goblin Bombardment and Orcish Bowmasters provide additional ways to pressure the opponent and control the battlefield. With a mixture of creature-based aggression and direct damage spells, this deck aims to maintain a relentless pace and close out games before the opponent can recover.

This deck focuses on utilizing low cmc spells to control the opponent's plays while setting up for a game-ending combo with Goblin Charbelcher. By casting spells like Disrupting Shoal and Pact of Negation, as well as using cards like Beyeen Veil and Suppression Ray, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy and buy time to assemble the necessary pieces. Once all is in place, the deck can use Whir of Invention to find and play Goblin Charbelcher, dealing massive damage to the opponent to secure the win.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays and quick damage output with a mix of creatures and burn spells. Additionally, it has the unique twist of including Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion for additional value. The deck aims to establish a strong board presence quickly using cards like Amped Raptor and Guide of Souls while disrupting the opponent's board with Static Prison. The inclusion of cards like Blood Moon and Galvanic Discharge adds flexibility to deal with a variety of threats, making Boros Aggro a versatile and powerful Modern deck.

This Mono Black Control deck focuses on utilizing hand disruption, efficient removal spells, and powerful late-game threats to control the game and outvalue opponents. By using cards like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek to disrupt the opponent's game plan, along with powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Soul Spike, the deck aims to grind out a win through attrition. The inclusion of cards like Agadeem's Awakening and Castle Locthwain provide additional flexibility and card advantage, while cards like Fatal Push and Necrodominance help control the board.

The main concept of this deck is to fill your graveyard with creatures and then use cards like Living End to bring them all back into play for a big burst of power. The deck includes cards that can cycle through your deck quickly to help you find the pieces you need, as well as cards that can disrupt your opponent's strategy to buy you time to set up your combo. Overall, the goal is to overwhelm your opponent with a strong board presence and win the game quickly.
